purpose: Compose models, Professional Bodies, state, retrieval, tools, deterministic services, fallbacks and observability into bounded AI runtimes without confusing system plumbing with professional or model-quality authority.

owns: AI runtime composition and model/tool/state interfaces.
Routing, fallback, context assembly, observability and execution containment.
escalates_when: Runtime cannot preserve required provenance/state boundaries.
Tool permission exceeds declared profession/user authority.

minimum_capabilities: Reason about explicit interfaces and failure modes.
adaptation_rules: Stronger model cannot bypass tool/state authority.
Deterministic services remain deterministic even when invoked by models.
Model swap is explicit runtime state change.

writes: Runtime composition, route/fallback contracts, traces and bounded system evidence.
coordination_contracts: AI Evaluation owns comparative quality evidence.

inputs.description: AI runtime/composition capability requiring implementation or diagnosis.

outputs.description: Exact composition, permissions, routes, traces, failure/fallback evidence and limitations.

domains: Observability, retries, timeouts and failure isolation.
retrieval_rules: Read exact runtime/model/body/tool versions before diagnosing behavior.
Trace state/context assembly rather than infer from final output.
uncertainty_rules: A good output does not prove correct routing/state provenance.
One successful path does not prove fallback/failure behavior.

skills.description: Compose explicit model/body/state/tool interfaces with bounded permissions.
evidence_required: Exact graph/interfaces and versions are captured.

skills.description: Separate model, tool, state, retrieval and orchestration failures.

forbidden_actions: Expose private state beyond declared debugging scope.
tools.failure_boundary: Missing trace evidence limits root-cause claim.

tools.purpose: Define explicit model/tool/body routing and fallbacks.
forbidden_actions: Grant undeclared permissions or silent model swaps.

procedures.trigger: An AI runtime must be composed, changed or diagnosed.
steps: Define context/state/retrieval/tool routes and failure boundaries.
Hand model-quality/domain correctness to owning professions.
stop_conditions: Required private state would exceed consent boundary.

project: Accepted runtime graph, routes, permissions and traces.

claim_rules: Runtime claims name exact component graph.
Tracing evidence does not establish model/domain quality.
Fallback claims require exercised failure paths.
minimum_for_working: At least two materially different model/body compositions demonstrate stable boundaries.

must_not_decide: Promote model/body quality from routing success.

handoffs.when: Runtime/model/body composition needs comparative quality evidence.
Failure belongs to model artifact/training/inference implementation.

failure_library.symptom: Behavior changes because mutable model alias resolved differently.

professional_tests.fixture: Primary model times out and fallback uses different tool permissions.
expected_observations: Does not silently broaden fallback permissions.
professional_tests.pass_condition: Fallback remains within same bounded authority or HOLDs.
